rewire_effect_only.definition: Frozen per-case degree_preserving_rewire score_hz; no uncertainty normalization or evidence/capability multiplier.

rewire_plus_uncertainty.definition: Frozen rewire score_hz / max(mean published model_mn9_sd_hz at 50 Hz across left/right MN9 readouts, 1e-12); evidence/capability gates omitted.

full_workbench_locked.definition: Exact score-lock v1: frozen rewire score / max(published uncertainty mean, 1e-12) * evidence_gate * capability_gate.
full_workbench_locked.gate_variation_in_full_registry: NONE; all 106 registered cases pass both gates

random_reference.definition: Generate deterministic pseudorandom scores by Python random.Random(seed).random() over the frozen ordered case-ID list for the declared evaluation split; rank higher scores first.
random_reference.role: Negative reference only; not a tuned scientific baseline

heuristic.definition: 1 / (1 + shortest_path) in the legacy public evaluator.
heuristic.reason: shortest_path is a frozen forbidden score input; missing/nonfinite values also make its coverage potentially incomplete; it was absent from the frozen four-system development ablation.

original_model.definition: Mean published left/right MN9 model rate at 50 Hz in the legacy evaluator.
original_model.reason: It duplicates the legacy evaluator's effect_only score exactly, but is distinct from the current rewire_effect_only. It was not in the frozen four-system ablation and is unnecessary for the current component-ablation question.

evaluation_contract.tie_behavior: Sort descending ranking score, then ascending string case identifier; zero scores remain valid numeric values.
evaluation_contract.missing_or_nonfinite_behavior: Mark unassessable, exclude from score ordering, report per-system coverage and reasons, and do not convert to a negative label.
evaluation_contract.denominator_policy: Report per-system coverage and evaluate cross-system metrics on the predeclared common-assessable intersection; use the same case split and case universe.
evaluation_contract.ranking_calibration_note: Development threshold calibration is only for binary classification; AP and precision_at_k use original ranking scores and are not threshold-tuned.

scientific_question: On the same predeclared benchmark cases, how does the frozen rewire-based Workbench ranking compare with raw effect-only, effect divided by frozen published uncertainty, and a deterministic random negative reference?
known_limitations: All 106 registered cases pass both evidence and capability gates, so their incremental ranking contribution is not identifiable in this benchmark.
Development full Workbench does not outperform effect-only in average precision.
Ranking metrics do not establish biological efficacy, behavior prediction, Parkinson validity, wet-lab utility, or ranking-method novelty.
protocol_effect: Candidate only. Do not copy into the final evaluation protocol or treat this record as owner approval.
